audience: Perplexity is for people who want an answer with the sources attached. The verdict still calls it the best cited AI search. That part is the product. The other half of the verdict is the reason this page is Pending: the consumer Pro monthly price was not on the pages we could open.

Buy only the rows we could actually read. Free is $0. Education Pro is $10 a month if you can pass SheerID. Enterprise Pro starts at $40 a month, or $400 a year, per seat. If you are a consumer looking for the ordinary Pro button, we do not have a price to defend.
features: Answers come with citations. That is the pro that separates this from a chat window that may or may not link out. For research, the citation is the feature, not a decoration.
Education Pro is a published $10 discount, which is the other pro. It requires SheerID verification. It is not a coupon code, and it is not the consumer Pro plan under another name.

Enterprise Pro is the paid row with a number: from $40 a month or $400 a year per seat. From means the card is a starting price. We do not have the higher seat prices, so we do not draw a ladder above $40.
